description: This Java test class verifies the functionality of the ComponentContainer, specifically its ability to initialize and load component configurations such as 'order' and 'accounting'. It includes setup and cleanup methods to handle test configuration directories and a test method for dependency checking.

classes.name: ComponentContainerTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying ComponentContainer's component loading and dependency handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by creating configuration directories.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Cleans up the environment by deleting configuration directories.

methods.name: testCheckDependencyForComponent
methods.description: Tests the component container's ability to load and resolve dependencies for components like 'order' and 'accounting'.
